project_name: Vetozone - Premium Veterinary Medical Ozone Generator
design_archetype: The Performance Pro & Swiss High-Contrast Hybrid (Elite Tactical Precision + Medical Authority)
theme_strategy: Hybrid Theme. Dark mode (Obsidian) for Hero and visual impact sections to highlight the Red/Black product. Light mode (Medical White) for data-heavy sections (Specs, Treatments) for clinical trust and readability.

typography.primary_font_usage: Headings, Large UI typography, Marquees (Provides an engineered, premium, authoritative feel). Do NOT use Inter.
typography.secondary_font_usage: Body text, UI elements, Data tables, Form inputs (Excellent legibility for technical data).

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter font-black leading-none

typography.installation: Import from Google Fonts (Manrope) and Fontshare (Cabinet Grotesk) in index.css

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly on the sticky Navbar and floating UI cards over the hero image. Settings: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 (Dark) or bg-white/70 (Light) with 1px border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Deep ambient shadows for product shots to create a 3D float effect. Sharp, high-contrast borders for standard cards.
visual_enhancers.gradients: No massive flat gradients. Use a radial spotlight gradient behind the main product in the hero (e.g., radial-gradient from #c8362f/20 to transparent) to make the black/red device pop.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) in the dark hero section to give a tactile, premium physical product feel.

motion.scrolling: Mandatory use of `lenis` for smooth, momentum-based scrolling. This is crucial for the premium feel.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line staggered text reveal using `framer-motion` (initial y: 100%, clip-path).
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero product image as the user scrolls down.
motion.hover_states: Buttons use fluid scaling (scale 0.98 on tap) and background color shifts. Links use an underline expansion effect.
motion.cards: Subtle y-axis lift (-translate-y-1) and border color illumination on hover.

layouts.grid_system: Bento 'Tetris' Grid for the features section. Asymmetric layouts heavily prioritized over symmetric center-aligned content.
layouts.spacing: Extremely generous. Sections should be padded with py-24 or py-32. Elements within features should use gap-8 or gap-12.

components_and_sections.name: Navigation
components_and_sections.instructions: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, subtle border-b). Includes Logo (text based with O3 mark), TR/EN Language Switcher (styled as sleek text toggle), and 'Request Quote' primary button. Z-index 50.

components_and_sections.name: Hero Section
components_and_sections.instructions: Massive asymmetric layout. Left: H1 text 'The New Standard in Veterinary Ozone Therapy' (in EN/TR based on state). Right: Placeholder for Product Image. Add a subtle radial red glow behind the product placeholder. Use a Framer Motion staggered reveal for the text.

components_and_sections.name: Manifesto Marquee
components_and_sections.instructions: react-fast-marquee. Massive outline text (Cabinet Grotesk text-8xl, transparent text, 1px white/black border) moving slowly. Text: '100% DOMESTIC PRODUCTION • VETERINARY EXCLUSIVE • CE CERTIFIED •'

components_and_sections.name: Features Bento Grid
components_and_sections.instructions: Grid cols-1 md:cols-12. Showcase features: 0.1-50 ug/ml Wide Dose Range (col-span-8), 800 mBar High Vacuum (col-span-4), 4.3 inch TFT Screen (col-span-4), Dual Catalyst Odorless Tech (col-span-8). Cards have sharp 1px borders, minimal padding, highly technical look.

components_and_sections.name: Target Species & Use Cases
components_and_sections.instructions: Tabs for Dogs & Cats, Horses, Cattle. Selecting a tab fades in the corresponding premium image and a list of specific treatment methods (Major Autohemotherapy, Saline, etc.). Image should fill the container with an elegant aspect ratio.

components_and_sections.name: Technical Specifications
components_and_sections.instructions: Light mode section. High contrast, clean, minimalist table for tech specs. border-collapse, subtle border-b on rows. Highly legible.

components_and_sections.name: Contact / Quote Form
components_and_sections.instructions: Split layout. Left: Persuasive text and contact info. Right: Shadcn Form. Must include working validation and a sleek, non-default styling (square inputs, brand red submit button).

components_and_sections.name: Footer
components_and_sections.instructions: Huge 'VETOZONE' text taking up the width of the screen. Clean links, copyright, CE/ÜTS badges.

media_and_images.rules: Use ONLY these URLs for corresponding sections. Never use dummyimage or placeholders.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass APCA/WCAG standards. Do NOT put unshadowed text over images. Use gradients or overlays.
accessibility.interactive: All buttons, tabs, and form elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium, Awwwards-level landing page. DO NOT USE STANDARD BOOTSTRAP-LIKE LAYOUTS.
Initialize and implement 'lenis' for smooth scrolling.
Implement 'framer-motion' for all entrance animations and text reveals.
Implement an i18n solution or simple React state Context for TR/EN language switching. The prompt explicitly requested English + Turkish.

The Hero section must have a dark background to make the brand's Red/Black physical device pop. Do not make the whole site dark; transition into light mode for the technical specs and medical details to build clinical trust.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) or Lucide (lucide-react) for a sharp, technical look.
Build the contact form using Shadcn UI form components but strip Vercel defaults; use sharp corners or 4px radiuses max to match the 'engineered' vibe.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use layered depth and sharp contrasts.
Do not center-align the main app container or standard text. Use left alignment for structure.
Add test IDs (`data-testid`) to all actionable elements.
